correctness.rationale: The classical even-subset quotient of ten ramification points is a symplectic F2^8 Weil module for J[2]. The complete RREF enumeration (200787 full-rank four-subspace matrices) and recursive isotropic-extension enumeration (layers 1,255,5355,11475,2295) produce identical exact sets of 2295 Lagrangians. The standalone script checks all 42 representative Frobenius conjugacy classes and three relabelled conjugates each; bitwise action is derived from permutation of even ten-subsets. The table follows for every odd finite field without curve enumeration. The script was run successfully.

value.rationale: Natural complete classification of rational polarized degree-16 isogeny kernel schemes in a genus-four hyperelliptic Jacobian, across all 42 Frobenius splitting types. It distinguishes integral Galois-stable subgroups from individual rational 2-torsion points, with contrasting 10- and 9+1-cycle types having identical rational two-torsion but 1 versus 0 kernels, and a 5+1^5 type with 16 rational torsion elements yet 0 kernels. Precise counts are useful for isogeny descent and arithmetic moduli, not arbitrary small finite recomputation.
